profile.description: S.N. Nuclearelectrica S.A. engages in the production and transmission of electricity and thermal energy in Romania. It produces and sells nuclear fuel bundles; processed uranium; and heat to the heat energy distribution company, as well as to end consumers in the Cernavoda Locality economic operators, economic agents, social and cultural institutions. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Bucharest, Romania.
